test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There is a special heritage for all of us in India, not an exclusive one, for none _________ exclusive when it comes to shared heritage.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, indicating a general truth. 
 
• The blank should be filled with a verb that agrees with the subject **"none."**
 
• "Beckons" is the present tense form of the verb **"beckon,"** which is appropriate for the present tense context of the sentence.
 
• **"None" **is a singular pronoun, so the verb should also be in the singular form.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** 'Beckons.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4.'**

Correct Sentence:__ There is a special heritage for all of us in India, not an exclusive one, for none **beckons **exclusive when it comes to shared heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) beckoning:** This is the present participle form of the verb "beckon," which is not suitable for the present tense context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2) have beckoned:** This is the present perfect tense of the verb "beckon," which is not suitable for the present tense context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3) beckoned:** This is the past tense form of the verb "beckon," which is not suitable for the present tense context of the sentence.
